We need number of CH3 groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly we need to get NMR spectra and infer number of methyl groups. Could use proton NMR to count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool. That will give spectrum string. Then we need to interpret peaks: methyl groups appear as singlet (or doublet etc) around 0.9-1.5 ppm, integration corresponds to 3H. But we don't have integration data. The tool likely returns a simplified list of peaks with multiplicity and integration? Not sure.

Alternative: maybe the molecule is known from context? No context given. So we must measure NMR.

We should first get proton NMR.
